purpose: Presentation contract only; no scientific verdict is derived by the viewer.

publication.notice: Chinese bounded status supplied by root
publication.approval: null in draft; otherwise repository-relative file, sha256 and exact approved input bindings

fixed_universe: Exactly the frozen 322 IDs in panel order. Filtering never changes this universe or any scientific denominator.
panels: panel, canvas_id, official_url, dimensions_px, original_panel_box_xyxy, original_image_sha256

row.original: box_xyxy, band_metadata_only, roster_class, full_seed_record, all_fine_alternatives (each exact original record)
row.coding_versions: Array of {version_id, observer_id, source, record}. v1 remains exact; corrected v2 remains separate. source={file:repo-relative,sha256,json_pointer}.
row.corrections: Array of {source, change_record}; exact change receipt for this ID, never silently apply a patch to v1.
row.cross_reviews: Array of {review_id,reviewer,coding_version_id,source,role_review,whole_window_review,H_review,raw_record}. Each review is bound to the precise coding version; retain disagreement without votes.
row.cross_review_import_state: NOT_IMPORTED, IMPORTED or NOT_APPLICABLE. Empty array does not mean agreement or no review happened.
row.root_adjudication: null until explicitly supplied. Then {state:adjudicated,source,reviewed_version_ids,review_ids,decision_record,reason,raw_record}. decision_record uses the scientific role/scope/writing/H fields; no frontend consensus computation. display_record is an explicitly labeled selected-record context projection overlaid by exact root decision_record fields, with root source_refs. decision_record itself stays exact.
row.root_import_state: NOT_IMPORTED or IMPORTED. Missing is not NA, rejected, or a scientific finding.
row.targeted_challenge_review: Optional within root_adjudication for the eight frozen diagnostic cases only: {source,raw_record,exposure,scope,root_acceptance}; separate from cross_reviews. Original exact fields remain visible, not an independent vote or overwrite.

source_reference_rule: Exact original_field_value and RFC6901 pointer remain available within each record. UI must distinguish factual source fields from first/review/root interpretations.
uncertainty_rule: unresolved_writing_or_graphic is a placeholder, never a certified role. V1 literal representation remains visible as historical data alongside correction receipt.
downloads: Explicit array {label,url,sha256}; no recursive discovery. Paths are repository-relative; no local absolute paths/private images.
release_gate: Final adapter must verify root approval plus every bound report/review/adjudication hash, all322 IDs, original boxes, all358 alternatives and immutable original candidates. It must not fill missing root judgments by copying latest coding or taking a majority.
display_rules: Original judgments, cross reviews and root adjudication are separate columns.
No scientific aggregate counts or percentages in this viewer skeleton; pagination totals are navigation only.
Full window is not full inscription; absence of an independent leader is not absence of spatial role.
Role presence, alternative candidates, placeholder uncertainty, evidence extent and H are distinct fields.
SVG overlays use original canvas pixel boxes, never angular reassignment or semantic arrows.

release_approval_schema.scientific_status: Root-supplied Chinese limitations; no sequence-gate upgrade.

scientific_acceptance: Root bounded acceptance source and exact record, separate from publication approval; mandatory limits remain visible.
